description_excerpt: Job Description • Lead BPS related activity in HcP in collaboration with Bosch worldwide (Eg: Suggestion scheme, 5S, BPS training, BPS competence management) and react on deviation or on input from stakeholder independently. • Implement internal standard of common BPS elements, tools(e.g: 5S, standardized work, SMC, VSP...) based on Work Instruction or Bosch guideline. Develop and improve BPS element base on value stream requirement in the manufacturing area (Maturity assessment). • Provide advance BPS training: Leading BPS in a BPS plant, Consumption Control and Levelling … in Bosch world…
